Name: mia-ingest-knowledge
Description: Re-read assafweb.com into Mia's brain, hourly (C12). A weekly cron let a Tuesday site edit sit unseen until the next Monday; the per-source content hash (app/brain/knowledge.py) makes an hourly re-check cheap -- an unchanged source costs one GET and zero embedding spend. This closes only the 'Mia lags the files' gap: the ingest run also checks whether the files themselves still track the live site (app/brain/site_freshness.py) and surfaces that separately, in the owner daily brief.
